Rotate PDF

Fix a sideways scan or an upside-down page. Rotate every page, or just the ones you choose, and download a corrected PDF.

How to use Rotate PDF

  1. Drop a PDF into the box.
  2. Choose the rotation and whether it applies to all pages or selected ones.
  3. Click Rotate and download the new PDF.

Frequently asked questions

Can I rotate only some pages?

Yes. Choose 'Selected pages' and enter numbers like 1, 3-5.

Is the file uploaded?

No. The change is made in your browser.
